title: Evolutionary Harness Metrics
description: Schema for aggregated metrics from the evolutionary evolution process.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the evolution run.

generation.description: The generation number of the evolutionary algorithm.

condition.description: The experimental condition under which this run was executed.

final_reward.description: Total accumulated reward over the episode.

policy_complexity_cc.description: Cyclomatic complexity of the evolved policy code.

policy_complexity_branches.description: Number of conditional branches in the policy.

explanation_success.description: Whether a valid counterfactual explanation was generated for failures.

explanation_latency_ms.description: Time taken to generate explanation in milliseconds.

shift_occurred.description: Whether a dynamic shift was triggered during this run.

pre_shift_reward.description: Cumulative reward before the shift step.

post_shift_reward.description: Cumulative reward after the shift step.

timestamp.description: ISO 8061 timestamp of the run completion.
